Amin Ghaffari this is not related to MO. WOF is a web activity. and all the web activities on Android are taking too long to load. FE team should find a solution to optimize the flow------

Alireza Javan:
Amin Ghaffari MO is implementing a 1-minute limit to automatically close web activities if they do not load successfully. If a web activity fails to load within this time frame, MO will close it and display an error message to the participant.------
